note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The bodies are abstract and fictional, drawn at the same size on one row (no rank, level or hierarchy); the route is ONLY the sequence supplied in routes.steps; the decision is a placeholder sheet. 'Route not checked' is a neutral pending state (dashed), never invalid. No admissibility, time limit, leave, ground, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn. Brief fields: decisions, routes, outcomes, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState are editable; actorLabels maps to courier.label (the participant) and routes.bodies[].label (the bodies). OMITTED brief field: grounds — grounds of a challenge would add legal content this motif does not need (the route alone is the subject); see review-01 for supplied labels.
